description: Prioritized upgrade plan for one project (project_path): the 4DA app's work order when computed (per-line targets, manifest vs lockfile fix), else the smallest version that fixes each vulnerability. Call when the user asks what to upgrade.

include_dev.description: Dev-only packages (labelled isDev). Default (unset): vulnerable devDependencies and dev-only transitive packages are planned, as in vulnerability_scan; true also checks every devDependency for newer releases and deprecation; false leaves dev-only packages out and the summary counts them.

package.description: Plan for this one package only (exact name, any ecosystem). Default: every dependency.

project_path.description: Project directory to plan for, from its lockfiles on disk. "*" for every project: with the 4DA app attached, the app's stored plan across every project it tracks (not checked against the lockfiles). Default: the project the server was started in, when that directory is a project.

risk_threshold.description: Only show upgrades at or above this risk level. Default: all

name: upgrade_planner
title: Upgrade planner
